limitations: The logic may not be suitable for systems with highly non-deterministic behavior, as the over-approximation techniques may lead to false positives.
The soundness and completeness proofs are currently limited to a specific class of programs, and further research is needed to extend them to more general cases.
The integration with existing logics may require significant effort to develop and maintain.
